## Walkthrough

The PR tightens CodeRabbit review completion criteria. A review object must be positively identified by its body prefix. Empty reply containers do not qualify, even when their `commit_id` matches the current head. Re-anchored inline comments do not independently prove review completion. Contract assertions verify these safeguards across the normative guidance, surveyor overlay, and parity checklist.

**Possibly related issues**

- devantler-tech/monorepo#2653: Both refine CodeRabbit green-review qualification by rejecting non-substantive artifacts.
- devantler-tech/monorepo#2697: Both require identifiable substantive CodeRabbit review objects instead of accepting empty containers.

**Possibly related PRs**

- [devantler-tech/monorepo#2677](https://github.com/devantler-tech/monorepo/pull/2677): This PR extends its positive CodeRabbit review-identification fix to additional contract surfaces.
